import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearModules
import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Subalgebra.Operations
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Finiteness.Descent

/-!
# Finite Galois descent of algebras

For a finite Galois extension `L/K`, a semilinear action on an `L`-algebra `R`
identifies `L` tensored with its fixed subalgebra with `R`. This is the affine
algebra step in Milne III.1.13. The proof adapts the sibling project's
`AlgebraicJacobian/Descent/SemilinearAlgebras.lean`, using Mathlib's
`FixedPoints.subalgebra` for the invariant algebra.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
variable (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R]
  [IsScalarTower K L R] [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R]

omit [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower K L R] in
/-- A semilinear ring action acts on scalar coefficients by the corresponding
field automorphism. -/
lemma smul_algebraMap [IsSemilinear K L R] (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (a : L) :
    g • algebraMap L R a = algebraMap L R (g a) := by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    smul_smul_apply, smul_one]

omit [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower K L R] in
/-- Compatibility on scalar coefficients suffices for semilinearity of a
ring action. -/
lemma isSemilinear_of_smul_algebraMap
    (h : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (a : L),
      g • algebraMap L R a = algebraMap L R (g a)) :
    IsSemilinear K L R where
  smul_smul' g a x := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, smul_mul', h, ← Algebra.smul_def]

/-- Galois automorphisms fix the base field, so the action commutes with
base-field scalars. -/
instance [IsSemilinear K L R] : SMulCommClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) K R where
  smul_comm g c x := by
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul L c x, smul_smul_apply,
      AlgEquiv.commutes, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]

variable [IsSemilinear K L R]

variable {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra K S] [Algebra L S]
  [IsScalarTower K L S] [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) S]
  [IsSemilinear K L S]

/-- Restriction of an equivariant algebra map to fixed-point subalgebras. -/
def fixedPointsAlgHom (f : R →ₐ[L] S)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : R), f (g • x) = g • f x) :
    FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →ₐ[K]
      FixedPoints.subalgebra K S (L ≃ₐ[K] L) where
  toFun x := ⟨f x, by
    intro g
    rw [← hf g x]
    exact congrArg f (x.2 g)⟩
  map_one' := by ext; simp
  map_mul' x y := by ext; simp
  map_zero' := by ext; simp
  map_add' x y := by ext; simp
  commutes' c := by ext; simp

@[simp]
theorem fixedPointsAlgHom_coe (f : R →ₐ[L] S)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : R), f (g • x) = g • f x)
    (x : FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) :
    (fixedPointsAlgHom K L R f hf x : S) = f x := rfl

@[simp]
theorem fixedPointsAlgHom_id
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : R), (AlgHom.id L R) (g • x) = g • (AlgHom.id L R) x) :
    fixedPointsAlgHom K L R (AlgHom.id L R) hf = AlgHom.id K _ := by
  ext x
  rfl

theorem fixedPointsAlgHom_comp
    {T : Type v} [CommRing T] [Algebra K T] [Algebra L T]
    [IsScalarTower K L T] [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) T]
    [IsSemilinear K L T]
    (f : R →ₐ[L] S) (g : S →ₐ[L] T)
    (hf : ∀ (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : R), f (σ • x) = σ • f x)
    (hg : ∀ (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : S), g (σ • x) = σ • g x) :
    fixedPointsAlgHom K L R (g.comp f)
        (fun σ x => by
          change g (f (σ • x)) = σ • g (f x)
          rw [hf, hg]) =
      (fixedPointsAlgHom K L S g hg).comp
        (fixedPointsAlgHom K L R f hf) := by
  ext x
  rfl

/-- The underlying module of the fixed-point subalgebra agrees with the
invariant subspace used in Speiser's theorem. -/
def fixedPointsLinearEquiv :
    FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ≃ₗ[K] invariants K L R where
  toFun x := ⟨x.1, x.2⟩
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  invFun x := ⟨x.1, x.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The canonical algebra map from the scalar extension of the invariants. -/
noncomputable def descentAlgHom :
    L ⊗[K] FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →ₐ[L] R :=
  AlgHom.liftEquiv K L _ R (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)).val

@[simp]
theorem descentAlgHom_tmul (a : L)
    (x : FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) :
    descentAlgHom K L R (a ⊗ₜ[K] x) = a • (x : R) := rfl

variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

/-- Speiser's module theorem makes the canonical algebra map bijective. -/
theorem descentAlgHom_bijective : Function.Bijective (descentAlgHom K L R) := by
  have h : ⇑(descentAlgHom K L R) = ⇑(descentMap K L R) ∘
      ⇑(TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl K L) (fixedPointsLinearEquiv K L R)) := by
    funext y
    induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul a x =>
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, descentAlgHom_tmul, TensorProduct.congr_tmul,
          LinearEquiv.refl_apply, descentMap_tmul]
        rfl
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [h]
  exact (descentMap_bijective K L R).comp (TensorProduct.congr _ _).bijective

/-- A semilinear Galois algebra is the scalar extension of its fixed algebra. -/
noncomputable def descentAlgEquiv :
    L ⊗[K] FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ≃ₐ[L] R :=
  AlgEquiv.ofBijective (descentAlgHom K L R) (descentAlgHom_bijective K L R)

@[simp]
theorem descentAlgEquiv_tmul (a : L)
    (x : FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) :
    descentAlgEquiv K L R (a ⊗ₜ[K] x) = a • (x : R) := rfl

/-- Speiser descent commutes with equivariant algebra maps. -/
theorem descentAlgEquiv_naturality (f : R →ₐ[L] S)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : R), f (g • x) = g • f x)
    (y : L ⊗[K] FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) :
    descentAlgEquiv K L S
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id K L)
          (fixedPointsAlgHom K L R f hf) y) =
      f (descentAlgEquiv K L R y) := by
  induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a x =>
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq,
        descentAlgEquiv_tmul, descentAlgEquiv_tmul]
      exact (map_smul f a (x : R)).symm
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

/-- Equivariant algebra maps are determined by their descended maps on fixed
subalgebras. -/
theorem fixedPointsAlgHom_injective (f g : R →ₐ[L] S)
    (hf : ∀ (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : R), f (σ • x) = σ • f x)
    (hg : ∀ (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : R), g (σ • x) = σ • g x)
    (h : fixedPointsAlgHom K L R f hf = fixedPointsAlgHom K L R g hg) :
    f = g := by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (descentAlgEquiv K L R).surjective x
  rw [← descentAlgEquiv_naturality K L R f hf,
    ← descentAlgEquiv_naturality K L R g hg, h]

/-- The comparison respects the Galois action, acting on the left tensor
factor on its source. -/
theorem descentAlgEquiv_map_left (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
    (y : L ⊗[K] FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) :
    descentAlgEquiv K L R
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (g : L →ₐ[K] L) (AlgHom.id K _) y) =
      g • descentAlgEquiv K L R y := by
  induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a x =>
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq,
        AlgEquiv.coe_algHom, descentAlgEquiv_tmul, descentAlgEquiv_tmul,
        smul_smul_apply, x.2 g]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, smul_add, hx, hy]

/-- A finite-type semilinear algebra descends to a finite-type fixed algebra. -/
theorem finiteType_fixedPoints [Algebra.FiniteType L R] :
    Algebra.FiniteType K (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) := by
  letI : Algebra.FiniteType L
      (L ⊗[K] FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.equiv (R := L) (by infer_instance)
      (descentAlgEquiv K L R).symm
  exact Algebra.FiniteType.of_finiteType_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat L

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
